title: WorkPulse CDC leave_requests row v1
description: Captured `leave_requests` columns for the leave fact — type reference, start date, approved day count and status. Reasons and decision notes never cross.

tenant_id.description: Tenant the row belongs to — enforced end-to-end.

employee_id.description: Employee the request belongs to (UUIDv7 string).

leave_type_id.description: Leave type reference; resolved to its code by the sink's leave-type dictionary.

start_date.description: First day of leave, Debezium epoch-day encoding.

days.description: Approved inclusive day count (`days`, the fold's `approved_day_count`).

status.description: Leave lifecycle status. The projection writes fact rows for `approved` only (terminal state).
